sloka: राज्ञा च भगवन् नित्यं राजपुत्रेण वा सदा ।यत्नत: परिहर्त्तव्या विषयेषु तपस्विन: ॥ २.९१.७॥
transliteration: rājñā ca bhagavan nityaṁ rājaputreṇa vā sadā ।yatnata: pariharttavyā viṣayeṣu tapasvina: ॥ 2.91.7॥

translations.english: O venerable one a king or a prince ought to intentionally avoid those places occupied by ascetics.
